summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Henry Wilke AI-Systemarchitekt website language switching (DE/EN) functionality. All pages tested successfully with bilingual content switching working correctly across all subpages.
passed_tests: Homepage language switching - Hero title changes between 'Building systems that think.' (EN) and 'Systeme bauen, die denken.' (DE)
Homepage whitepaper CTA banner renders correctly with FileArrowDown icon
Navigation labels change correctly between DE and EN (Start/Home, Leistungen/Services, Referenzen/Portfolio, Über mich/About, Automatisierung/Automation, Kontakt/Contact)
Leistungen/Services page - Hero label and title change with language ('Services'/'Leistungen', 'What I offer'/'Was ich anbiete')
Leistungen page - Difference section cards display bilingual content (Strategische KI-Architektur/Strategic AI Architecture, etc.)
Leistungen page - Workflow steps display bilingual content (Analyse/Analysis, Systemmodell/System Model, etc.)
Über mich/About page - Hero and bio text change with language
Über mich page - Audience section (Zielgruppe/Target Audience) displays bilingual content
KI-Automatisierung/Automation page - All sections display bilingual content (Grundlagen/Fundamentals, benefits, architecture points)
Kontakt/Contact page - Form labels change with language (Ihr Name/Your Name, E-Mail-Adresse/Email Address, etc.)
Kontakt page - Submit button text changes (Anfrage senden/Send request)
Kontakt page - Placeholders change with language
Referenzen/Portfolio page - Hero and CTA section use translations (ctaTitle, ctaText, ctaButton)
Referenzen page - Project details display bilingual content (Herausforderung/Challenge, Lösung/Solution, etc.)
Whitepaper page - Bilingual content working
Blog page - Hero title changes with language ('Thoughts & Insights'/'Gedanken & Erkenntnisse')
Footer text changes correctly between DE and EN (Rechtliches/Legal, Impressum/Imprint, AGB/Terms, etc.)
Cookie banner text changes between DE and EN (Cookie-Einstellungen/Cookie Settings, Alle akzeptieren/Accept all)
Contact form submission works correctly - POST /api/contact returns success
Language context persists via localStorage across page navigation
context_for_next_testing_agent: All language switching functionality has been verified across all pages. The LanguageContext uses localStorage to persist language preference. The language switcher is located in the top-right navigation bar and shows the opposite language code (shows 'DE' when in English mode, 'EN' when in German mode). All pages use the useLanguage() hook from LanguageContext.jsx and translations from /app/frontend/src/data/translations.js. Contact form submission to POST /api/contact is working correctly.
